title: GrabCAD Pulse: New Home Screen for GrabCAD Print | Statasys
summary: Meet GrabCAD Pulse, the new home screen in GrabCAD Print 1.120 for printer status, licenses, recent projects, product updates and support.
body_markdown:
## What can you do with


GrabCAD


Pulse?


- **Licenses.** View every license available to your company, how many seats are in use, whether a license is a trial and when it expires.


- **Administrators.** Find your company’s GrabCAD administrators and their email addresses, so you know who to contact when you need help.


- **Printer Status.** See what each printer is doing and how much material is left, with a link to the full printer view when you need more detail.


- **Recent Projects.** Return to your latest .print files with thumbnails, file sizes and the date each project was last modified. Select a project to pick up where you left off.


- **News & Updates.** Review product updates, materials news and Stratasys event announcements. An unread count makes new items easy to identify.


- **Knowledge Base.** Search documents, eLearning modules, support pages and videos already filtered for your printer.
